blurb: Guests can rent kayaks and paddleboards for self-guided exploration or join guided kayak tours to see wildlife like manatees and dolphins. Tours include paddling lessons, safety orientation, and are led by expert guides knowledgeable about local ecology. Rentals and tours operate at multiple locations with varying scenery including mangrove tunnels and coastal islands.
